description: This file contains functions and types related to video generation, including resolving candidates, handling errors, and orchestrating video generation requests with fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveVideoGenerationCandidates
methods.description: Resolves a list of candidate video generation models and providers based on configuration and fallback values.

methods.name: throwVideoGenerationFailure
methods.description: Throws an error after all video generation attempts have failed, including details of attempts and last error.

methods.name: buildNoVideoGenerationModelConfiguredMessage
methods.description: Builds an error message indicating no video generation model is configured, with hints for setup.

methods.name: listRuntimeVideoGenerationProviders
methods.description: Lists available video generation providers based on configuration.

methods.name: generateVideo
methods.description: Main function to generate a video, trying multiple candidates with fallback and error handling.
